summary: A London dental practice appears to lose new patients to unfinished cookie banner text and no copyright year or quick message option.

findings.problem: The cookie settings text appears to show unfilled placeholders such as Manage {vendor_count} vendors and {title} repeated.
findings.cost: Placeholder code in a consent banner makes the site look broken, and patients trust a broken site less.

findings.problem: The footer appears to say Copyright Blue Dental Care with no year.
findings.cost: A footer with no year gives no sign the practice is active.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp or text option appears next to the phone number.
findings.cost: Patients who want a quick answer message first.
findings.fix: A one tap text button and online booking.
